purpose: IMDb classification optimization only; no generation experiments or course report

data_rule.split: Preserve the original normalized-text groups and saved 22500/2500 split
data_rule.vocabulary: Fit only on the 22500 training examples
data_rule.candidate_test_access: Training loads only official train and its validation partition; no candidate official-test metrics

budget.initial_plan: Approximately 8 screening runs, then 2 additional seeds for each of the top 2 configurations (approximately 12 runs total)
budget.adaptation: Choose later comparisons from validation evidence; stop refinements at a validation plateau
budget.per_run: At most 30 epochs; early stop after 8 epochs without lower validation loss

stages: A: GRU 256 head reproduction, 512 head, 512 first256+last256
B: at the promising input view compare BiGRU and BiLSTM; test hidden 256 if capacity looks limiting
C: compare masked mean with max or mean+max on a promising architecture
D: at most two targeted training refinements, such as AdamW with weight decay, learning-rate schedule, or dropout
checkpoint_rule: For every run use the earliest checkpoint with the lowest validation cross-entropy.
screening_rule: Rank seed-1704 configurations by validation accuracy at the selected checkpoint; ties use lower validation loss, then fewer parameters. Take the top two configurations to replication.
replication_rule: Keep the split seed at 1704. For each of the two selected configurations use model/training seeds 1704, 1705, and 1706. Choose highest three-seed mean validation accuracy; ties use lower mean validation loss, then fewer parameters.
final_seed_rule: Evaluate only the winning configuration's seed with median validation accuracy. Accuracy ties use lower validation loss, then smaller numerical seed.
final_test_rule: Write selection.json with configuration and checkpoint SHA-256 before explicit official-test evaluation. Report the selected seed's full 25000-example metrics.
historical_test_disclosure: The original GRU baseline official-test accuracy of 87.184 percent was already viewed; the official test set cannot be described as completely unseen.
